definitions.explanation: A tall structure or tower used to display advertisements, typically found in urban areas.
A person who serves as the public representative of an organization or cause, often implying they are being used mainly for promotional purposes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{広告塔|こうこくとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a large advertising tower in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{広告塔|こうこくとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{撤去|てっきょ}→撤去：14729_tekkyo⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The old advertising tower was removed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{繁華街|はんかがい}→繁華街：09392_hankagai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{広告塔|こうこくとう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ネオン→ネオン：08835_neon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{光|ひか}っている→光る：01163_hikaru⟧。
examples.english: The advertising towers in the entertainment district are lit up with neon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{団体|だんたい}→団体：03426_dantai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{広告塔|こうこくとう}だ。
examples.english: He is the figurehead of that organization.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}{人|じん}→有名人：17812_yuumeijin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{広告塔|こうこくとう}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{利用|りよう}→利用：01752_riyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A celebrity was used as a poster child.

examples.japanese: ⟦{詐欺|さぎ}→詐欺：09789_sagi⟧⟦グループ→グループ：03840_guruupu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{広告塔|こうこくとう}になっていたこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発覚|はっかく}した→発覚する：15423_hakkakusuru⟧。
examples.english: It was revealed that he had been serving as the public face of a fraud group.

notes:
USAGE:
The figurative sense (sense 2) is very common in news reporting, especially when discussing celebrities or public figures who lend their name and image to organizations, sometimes unknowingly or for dubious purposes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {広告塔|こうこくとう}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (to be used as a figurehead)
- {広告塔|こうこくとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become a poster child)
- {広告塔|こうこくとう}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧ (figurehead-like presence)
